answer: We model a mechanism where identities lock staking collateral subject to zero-knowledge verifiable delays. This creates a vast ocean of illiquid capital acting as a lantern to expose attackers. By configuring subgame-perfect slashing penalties, the marginal utility of identity multiplication across this cryptographic dune is rendered strictly negative. Consequently, dynamic opportunity-cost bonds guarantee that the honest validation strategy remains the unique, robust Nash equilibrium under any rational adversary model.
